detail: Browser spec 24.spec.ts. Two accepted cards (werk-shots 'Pasted screenshots', tower 'Power cards'); typed 'Look at #wer'. Menu opens listing #werk-shots with its title; ArrowDown/ArrowUp keep selection on it; Enter gives 'Look at #werk-shots '; menu closes; '`#wer' opens no menu. FAILS only the position: the menu has CSS bottom:100% and opens ABOVE the composer (menu y=536, composer y=614), not below the caret. Note: a proposed (ghost) card is not offered; I accepted the cards first.

Typed text, pasted a real PNG via a ClipboardEvent; composer shows 'What is wrong here? [Image #1]'; chip shows spinner (upload delayed 800ms by a network route to observe it) then a decodable thumbnail; Enter: the fake agent's message holds '[Image #1] = <project>/.werk/attachments/<name>.png' and 'Open each image above with Read'; git status -uall shows nothing under attachments.

Dropped a 25 MB PNG-headed file on the composer; composer shows [Image #1], chip shows reason with '20 MB'. I typed text first, because with only the token the composer sends nothing. Enter: message has no path and no token; attachments folder holds no image file.

Pasted PNG then JPEG; two chips with thumbnails and '[Image #1][Image #2]'. Removed chip 1: composer reads '[Image #1]', one chip remains whose thumbnail src is the .jpg; Enter: message maps [Image #1] to the .jpg path, no #2.

GET image with empty name, no name, '../../package.json', encoded '..%2F' and '/etc/passwd' all answer 404 with no file content. Then, after a first turn in which the fake agent names its slash commands (the menu has none before that), typing '/' opens the command menu.

Pasted PNG: chip shows spinner, composer has '[Image #1]', then thumbnail with token '[Image #1]'; after typing and Enter, the agent's message has '[Image #1] = /.werk/attachments/*.png', the 'Open each image above with Read' line, and no image bytes. FAILS: the sent message in the chat log shows only text; no appears under '[Image #1]' (client/app/chat-log.tsx renders turn.text only).

Pasted a ~2 MB noise PNG (thumbnail) and a 25 MB PNG (chip shows 'larger than 20 MB'); removed chip 2: '[Image #2]' leaves the text; typed a question and Enter: the turn lists only [Image #1] with its stored path, no #2.

Pasted red and blue PNGs; removed chip for [Image #1]: remaining chip shows [Image #1], composer holds the token once and no #2, the thumbnail is the blue image; Enter maps [Image #1] to the stored name of the kept image.

Upload delayed 1500ms by a network route; with the spinner showing, typed a question and Enter: no message reached the agent while the spinner showed; after the upload the message went out with '[Image #1] = <stored png path>'.
After a paste stored an image (served 200), an empty name, '../../package.json' and encoded climbing names answer 404; a second paste shows its thumbnail and the chat still answers ('Answer 1').
